outcome: Presence of written postpartum hemorrhage protocol
finding: French maternity units showed significant improvement in the management of postpartum hemorrhage according to the 2004 French guidelines, particularly in the third stage of labor, with no significant differences observed between hospitals based on levels of care or legal status.
mod_finding: Manual removal of the placenta after cesarean section was significantly more frequent in level I than level III units and in private than other types of maternity units.
